search_text: published ZDI-21-693 ZDI-CAN-12128 Fortinet FortiClient Incorrect Permission Assignment Privilege Escalation Vulnerability 2021-06-17 CVE-2021-26089 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2021-26089 7.8 AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Fortinet'] ['FortiClient'] This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Fortinet FortiClient on Apple macOS. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the FortiClient installer. The issue lies in the lack of proper permissions set on log files created by the installer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of root. Fixed in version 7.0.0 ['2021-02-03 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2021-06-17 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] Csaba Fitzl (@theevilbit) of Offensive Security https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-21-693/
title: Fortinet FortiClient Incorrect Permission Assignment Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Fortinet FortiClient on Apple macOS. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the FortiClient installer. The issue lies in the lack of proper permissions set on log files created by the installer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of root.
